source: User specified MiniFab buffers, direct operation intake and material recovery, then answered four edge cases.

agreed.initialOutputCapacity: One item or complete multi-output recipe batch
agreed.intake: One complete immediate operation from uncommitted inventory just before starting; assigned job only
agreed.missingStock: Valid request waits for a complete next operation; no partial intake
agreed.outputFullAndBagFull: Pause with items retained, notify and resume when capacity returns
agreed.deadlockException: Validate next full operation intake that genuinely frees bag capacity, ingest then deliver held output
agreed.productionCredit: Once at output-buffer completion; delivery/direct use is transfer only
agreed.cancel: Discard unfinished operation work, retain original ingredients and completed output; return if possible or keep buffers
agreed.residualRecipeCompatibility: Same input material types; quantities may differ
agreed.unclearedOutput: Other compatible recipe waits; exact same cancelled recipe may start if another complete result fits
agreed.recovery: Full solid equivalent: scrap-origin as scrap, other material as source ore needing full reprocessing; liquids lost
agreed.recraftHistory: Every genuinely completed craft counts; recovery/refunds/transfers do not
agreed.research: Permanent consumption; pause/switch only, never cancel or refund

laterDesign: Handling module/buffer upgrade costs and tiers
Source-ore equivalents and alternate recipe origin tracking
supersedes: Initial manual feeding, bag-only MiniFab output capacity and all-materials-to-scrap assumptions. Per-request intake is distinct from autonomous replenishment; output-buffer commits are production, later transfers are not.
